verdict.rationale: Jan is an open-source project with a public GitHub repo (janhq/jan), and the repo includes a setup command that installs dependencies, builds core components, and launches the app. That makes code contribution plausible, but nothing in the evidence describes how contributions are accepted or how contributors become recognized collaborators. Missing for 10: a contributing guide, a PR/review process, contributor recognition or maintainer pathways, governance docs, and community or hands-on evidence of external contributions being merged.
